name: 20755 · Fort Meade, MD
findings: ZIP 20755 (Fort Meade) has 17 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20755 (Fort Meade) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 20755 (Fort Meade) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).
